source.title: Critical Result Notification
source.note: User-edited source with Title, Guidelines, Guardrails, Key terminology; address removed by user. Exact 43 source labels preserved. Source approval metadata unavailable. Proposed annotations are not policy.

notification_requirements.source_clause: Organizational policy requires verbal notification for all critical results within sixty (60) minutes.
Notification requires Vesta to make a call to the facility contact listed for critical findings, the date and time of the notification should be noted in the Impression of the final report.
notification_requirements.destination: facility contact listed for critical findings
notification_requirements.recipient_name_note: Not explicitly required in supplied excerpt; may be a proposed improvement or required elsewhere.

notification_requirements.source_clause: Known findings will not be called unless there is a significant change - per the doctor’s judgment *

routing_authority.potential_critical: Separate draft message for radiologist review; no add-back solely for this concern.
routing_authority.report_discrepancy: Separate correction draft; follow approved worklist process.

interpretation_status: Proposed matching safeguards and clarification notes are not approved additions to the source policy.
unresolved_common_fields: uncertain diagnosis handling except explicit suspicion in abuse entry
modality/clinical population applicability where not explicit

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 1 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Does cerebral include subarachnoid, subdural, epidural, intraventricular, and intraparenchymal hemorrhage? No acute qualifier is written; clarify chronic collections via the shared known-finding rule.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 2 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Define included herniation syndromes and whether impending or suspected herniation qualifies; do not infer syndrome from isolated mass effect.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 3 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Preserve acute. Distinguish current reported stroke from prior infarct or history; suspected/age-indeterminate stroke needs clarified handling.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 4 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Clarify which intracranial infections and uncertain descriptions are included; do not equate nonspecific enhancement with infection.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 5 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Define complex and the qualifying report descriptors; do not convert all skull fractures to complex.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 6 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Define instability evidence and physician determination; do not classify every vertebral fracture as unstable.

rules.source_label: Spinal Cord Compression, hemorrhage or infarct
rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 7 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Keep the three concepts traceable to one source bullet. Clarify cauda equina/conus and spinal canal stenosis without stated cord compression.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 8 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Clarify threatened versus actual compromise and relevant descriptors; narrowing alone does not automatically establish the policy label.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 9 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Preserve acute; clarify age-indeterminate occlusion and inclusion of specific vascular territories.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 10 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Clarify suspected disease and descriptive findings; do not diagnose it independently from soft tissue gas alone.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 11 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Preserve tension. Ordinary pneumothorax is not an exact match to this item; serious out-of-list concerns must remain visible for human review.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 12 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Clarify scope of free air and postoperative/procedural findings. Do not invent a postoperative exemption or match air in every anatomic compartment.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 13 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Clarify whether pneumatosis alone is a listed trigger or requires reported ischemia; do not silently treat the parenthesis as proof of diagnostic equivalence.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 14 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Preserve active; a hematoma alone does not establish active bleeding, but another catalog item may apply.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 15 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Clarify report-suspected tamponade; do not replace pericardial effusion with tamponade.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 16 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Preserve both concepts; clarify suspected versus definite and overlap with Bowel Obstruction.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 17 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Define organ-specific grading reference/version and high-grade thresholds; do not invent a grade cutoff.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 18 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: No active or acute qualifier is written; do not add one. Evaluate current versus historical and the shared known-finding rule.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 19 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: No high-grade, complete, ischemic, or closed-loop restriction is written. Clarify partial obstruction and obstruction-versus-ileus uncertainty without narrowing the source.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 20 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: No perforation or complication restriction is written. Clarify equivocal wording, not an unsupported complicated-only threshold.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 21 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Clarify variants of terminology and current/historical context; do not substitute pneumobilia.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 22 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Clarify suspected ectopic and pregnancy of unknown location; no rupture requirement is written.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 23 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Preserve three distinct concepts under the original bullet. Define gestational/context handling and previa versus low-lying placenta; do not invent a bleeding prerequisite.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 24 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Preserve acute; clarify age-indeterminate and chronic dissection with interval change.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 25 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Preserve rupture or impending rupture. Aneurysm size alone is not a source-specified rupture threshold.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 26 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: No acute-only, size, or right-heart-strain threshold is written; use source wording and shared known-finding rule.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 27 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Preserve both organs; clarify suspected, intermittent, or resolved torsion.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 28 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Define device-specific significance and acceptable terminology; do not classify every positional variation as significant.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 29 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Proposed synonym pneumomediastinum needs reviewed mapping; postoperative/procedural exemptions are not supplied.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 30 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Clarify gestational setting and diagnostic wording; absent cardiac activity in an incompletely characterized early pregnancy must not be independently diagnosed as demise.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 31 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Clarify included locations and suspected abscess; no size threshold is written and generic fluid collection is not identical to abscess.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 32 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Preserve active. Do not diagnose active TB from scarring, a positive screening test, or nonspecific imaging descriptors.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 33 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Preserve acute; do not equate cholelithiasis or nonspecific wall thickening with acute cholecystitis.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 34 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Preserve new; define what evidence establishes new and how age-indeterminate DVT is handled. Do not invent newness from missing priors.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 35 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Do not equate generic pleural effusion with blood; no separate size threshold is supplied.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 36 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Suspicion is explicit in the source. Do not require confirmed abuse or infer abuse from demographics alone. Mandatory-reporting obligations are outside this document's specified workflow.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 37 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: No complication restriction is written. Clarify equivocal language without narrowing to perforation or abscess.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 38 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Preserve acute; distinguish uncertain, chronic, and current acute descriptions without inferring diagnosis from nonspecific marrow findings.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 39 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: No size, site, or rupture threshold is written. Clarify scope without creating exclusions.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 40 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Define clinical/report evidence of syndrome; SVC narrowing or occlusion does not independently establish clinical syndrome.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 41 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Define critical, measurement method, relevant vessels, and near-occlusion handling; do not invent a percentage.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 42 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: No acute qualifier is written; do not import it from Acute Aortic dissection.

rules.source_locator: critical-result-notification-source.txt: bullet 43 in finding list; excludes global clauses and address
rules.review_note: Clarify whether Foreign body means any foreign body or retained procedural material; intentional implants and devices are not automatically retained errors.
